attributes.description: Every audited event for the current selection by hour of day and day of week, over the last 7 days in UTC - one cell is one specific hour, not an average, because a seven-day window holds each hour of the week exactly once. Strength is volume on a log scale, so a quiet hour stays visible beside a busy one; a bare grey slot is an hour with no events at all. The current hour is still filling, so it is outlined rather than coloured: coloured, its first minutes read as a sudden drop after the full hours before it. Fixed window: this panel does not follow the time picker. No noise gate: it measures presence, so it will not reconcile with Signal events. UTC is stated rather than localised so the chart reads the same for every viewer, whatever their timezone - read the rhythm, not the clock.
attributes.title: [Audit] Activity Punchcard
